description: This file defines the 'Mail' entity class within the OrangeHRM project, representing email messages queued for sending. It includes properties for email recipients, subject, body, timestamps, status, and content type, and implements the Mail interface. It uses Doctrine ORM for database mapping and includes constants for status and content types.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Entity class representing an email message in the mail queue, with properties for recipients, subject, body, timestamps, status, and content type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the mail record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the mail record.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email record was created.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was sent.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current sending status of the email.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the email's sending status, validating allowed status values.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the email content type, validating allowed types.
